findings.summary: Sample checks claim requirements R1–R3 are covered in milestones M1 and M2, but milestone M2 exit_criteria do not explicitly include the linked acceptance tests (AT1–AT3) or any equivalent verification, weakening trace coverage for M2.

evidence.note: R1 sample check lists milestones [M1, M2]
R2 sample check lists milestones [M1, M2]
R3 sample check lists milestones [M1, M2]
M2 exit criteria list does not include AT1/AT2/AT3 (or equivalent checks)
M1 exit criteria explicitly include AT1/AT2/AT3 coverage

findings.summary: R1 states the system must accept exactly one frozen plan_package_final.json as the sole canonical planning input, but AT1 does not test the "exactly one" aspect (e.g., multiple plan_package_final.json inputs), creating a semantic gap between requirement and acceptance coverage.

evidence.note: R1 includes "accept exactly one frozen plan_package_final.json"
AT1 tests chat logs/unapproved artifacts but not multiple plan_package_final.json inputs

findings.summary: R2 and R3 require typed, versioned schemas for repo_context.json and workspace_context.json, but AT2/AT3 procedures do not explicitly verify schema versioning fields/semantics (only general schema-valid vs invalid), which may under-test the "versioned" requirement detail depending on schema design.

evidence.note: R2 includes "typed, versioned repo_context.json schema"
AT2 describes missing/invalid/valid but does not mention version field checks
R3 includes "typed, versioned workspace_context.json schema"
AT3 describes missing/invalid/valid but does not mention version field checks
